precedence: This override is authoritative only for the standalone public 226.futureperfect.education marketing-video surface. It does not alter authenticated Portal V2, Admin, Quiz, Trial, student access, lesson release, protected resources, parent email, catalogue, or read-model semantics.

ownerRequirement.purpose: A public URL that can be sent directly to prospective parents and presents the marketing video in the same visual language and 16:9 player frame as Portal V2 lesson videos.

hostingDecision.rationale: Keep ScreenPal for its existing player/streaming behavior while the parent-facing URL and presentation remain FPT-controlled. The page can switch video backend later without changing the parent URL.

presentationElementsCopied: white rounded portal card with navy top border

isolationInvariant.rule: Changes to this marketing page must not deploy, replace, bind to, or mutate Portal V2/Quiz Workers or Portal data stores.

updateRule.sameVideoProviderReplacement: Replace only the ScreenPal ID/embed URL on this isolated Worker, preserve the public hostname and Portal-style presentation, verify live iframe source and absence of autoplay.
updateRule.providerMigration: The parent-facing hostname remains 226.futureperfect.education. A future move to R2/Cloudflare Stream/another provider must change only the isolated marketing surface unless separately authorised.
prohibited: adding autoplay without a new owner instruction
routing the public marketing page through authenticated Portal APIs
adding Portal/Quiz data bindings to the marketing Worker
changing lessons.futureperfect.education or quiz.futureperfect.education to deploy this page
